metadata.title: NASA OPERA DISP-S1 ground motion at FISP buildings (measured, quality-filtered)
metadata.measurement: Line-of-sight (LOS) velocity relative to the surrounding ~2 km
metadata.sign_convention: positive = motion toward the satellite (≈ uplift); negative = away (≈ subsidence)
metadata.velocity_definition: Per building: median velocity of good 30 m pixels within 50 m of the footprint centroid, minus the ~2 km background (300 m block medians, 2.1 km moving median). This removes a ~5 mm/yr long-wavelength artefact ramp across the city; velocities are relative, not absolute.
metadata.vertical_approx_definition: velocity_mm_yr / 0.792 (median LOS up-component); assumes purely vertical motion
metadata.velocity_se_definition: formal least-squares standard error (white-noise assumption; optimistic)
metadata.quality_definition: 0–1 mean of rescaled temporal coherence (0.7→1), good-pixel share within 50 m, and pixel support (n/9)
metadata.relative_to: ~2 km surroundings (not absolute; regional subsidence and the artefact ramp are removed)
metadata.limitations: Block-scale motion of the built surface measured from orbit (30 m pixels shared with neighbours), relative to the surrounding ~2 km; it is NOT a structural-safety measure, at building scale it is mostly below the noise floor, and adding it did not improve the façade model.

provenance.buildings: NYC Open Data: FISP filings xubg-57si (BINs), Building Footprints 5zhs-2jue, PLUTO 64uk-42ks
